answer: Graduated influence vesting resists sybils: an identity's voting and grading weight is not granted at mint but accrues slowly with continuous active tenure and decays toward zero after any idle gap, so weight tracks sustained presence, not key count. A day-one fake on a fresh ledge carries almost none; to give a falcon-swarm of fakes real influence an operator must keep every head active across the long accrual window, a terrace of many epochs. Cost scales with keys times window — mass minting yields mass weightlessness, and decay erases any fake parked to ripen untended.
